llm_response.reason: The site exhibits numerous scam characteristics: promises of unrealistically high leverage (up to 125x) and 'no liquidation risk,' which are used to lure users with unrealistic returns; uses psychological urgency tactics ('start your crypto journey today,' 'find your next moonshot'); lacks any verified company information (recent domain registration, all WHOIS info redacted, no visible Team/About/Contact links); absence of any hyperlinks for terms, contact, FAQ or regulatory disclosures is highly abnormal for a trading platform; offers credit card crypto buying with no credible partners shown; and displays no evidence of proper payment/banking/licensing. These traits strongly match the profile of a Cryptocurrency Scam website.
